title: Android Timeline raw event
description: A single timestamped observation. Raw events are append-only and are never rewritten once stored; derived features are computed separately and may be recomputed at any time.

event_id.description: Globally unique id. Usually a deterministic UUIDv5 derived from device, source, type, event time and payload so that replaying an observation cannot create a duplicate.

device_id.description: Pseudonymous device identifier. Never a hardware serial, IMEI or phone number.

source.description: Stable collector name, e.g. battery, wifi, tasker.

event_time_utc.description: When the observation happened, in UTC.

collected_time_utc.description: When the collector observed it, in UTC. Differs from event_time_utc for backfilled or late-arriving data.

timezone_offset_minutes.description: Device local timezone offset from UTC at event time. Retained so wall-clock time can be reconstructed without guessing.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope. Stored per event so historical data stays interpretable after the schema evolves.

quality_flags.description: Annotations about trustworthiness. Never change the meaning of payload.

payload.description: Source-specific body. Intentionally unconstrained here: payload shapes are versioned by source and documented in docs/data-model.md.
